notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's first result, "need-for-speed" (id 3090, released 2015-11-03, Ghost Games), is the 2015 game. No StrategyWiki page under "Need for Speed (2015)": that title is only a red link from StrategyWiki's "The Need for Speed" page, and "Need for Speed" there is the 1994 original, so nothing was used. nfs.fandom.com answers the API under "Need for Speed (2015)", with about 178 linked pages, including "Amy", "Magnus Walker", "Ken Block", "Nakai-san", "Morohoshi-san" and "Manu"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1262540 is "Need for Speed™". None of the 45 Steam achievements is hidden. Which story line each Icon belongs to is taken only from achievements that sit next to each other (for example "Beat Magnus' record time" then "Become a Speed Icon"); "Amy" is placed in Getting Started as an early, high-unlock (33%) story step. The Eddie, Hot Rod, Drag Race, Prestige and Speedlist goals have low unlock rates (1 to 10%) and may come from later free updates, but nothing in the data says so. Some goals ("Share a Wrap", "Download a shared wrap", daily challenges) need online play.
